name: Item Convert
description: Converts an item into another one when it is given to a player who cannot use the original: used for cross-faction/race item equivalents (target item's allowable races must not overlap the original's) and for Bind-on-Account items whose reputation requirement the receiver does not meet. Loaded by ObjectMgr::LoadItemConverts.

fields.name: Converted Item
fields.help: The item the player receives instead.

fields.name: Target Item
fields.help: Open the item it converts into.
